toegepas.blok: Genoeg, en nie te veel nie
toegepas.voor: op jou bord is nog nie balans nie
toegepas.na: op jou bord beteken nog nie balans nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: A noun phrase 'elke groep ... op jou bord' cannot naturally 'be' balance; 'beteken' says what is meant at the same word count.
toegepas.fout: 'Elke groep erens op jou bord is nog nie balans nie' equates a situation with 'balans' and reads stiffly.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'beteken nog nie balans nie' says the intended point naturally at the same word count, meaning unchanged.

toegepas.voor: van sy ouderdom en grootte en hoe
toegepas.na: van sy ouderdom, grootte en hoe
toegepas.rede_vinder: A list of three items takes a comma rather than a repeated 'en'; same word count.
toegepas.fout: A three-item list joined by a repeated 'en' reads clumsily.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Comma for the first join is the normal list form, one word shorter, same three factors.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Drank' on its own easily reads as alcohol; 'drankies' is the natural word for sweet drinks for a Grade 6 learner.
toegepas.fout: 'soet drank' on its own can read as alcohol.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'soet drankies' is the natural, unambiguous word for a Grade 6 reader at the same word count; the instruction itself is unchanged.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Dit' could refer back to 'jou liggaam'; naming vesel removes the ambiguity at the same word count.
toegepas.fout: 'dit' can point back to 'jou liggaam' instead of 'vesel'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming vesel removes the ambiguous pronoun at the same word count and leaves the protected clause before the comma intact.

toegepas.voor: Botter is vet en suikerbone gee ook vesel
toegepas.na: Botter is vet, en suikerbone gee ook vesel
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two clauses with their own subject and verb, so a comma goes before it.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Botter is vet' and 'suikerbone gee ook vesel' are full clauses, so the comma is required.

toegepas.fout: The verbs 'gedoen het' and 'veroorsaak' collide, which makes the reader stumble.
toegepas.rede_keurder: A comma closing the embedded relative clause eases reading without touching the protected 'gewoonlik' wording or the claim.
